best_gate.limitation: Neutral resets do not vary physical initial conditions across seeds. These rollouts establish reproducibility, not perturbation or transition robustness.

comparison.selection: Physical rollout completion, no termination, final success, drift/speed, then reward.

robustness.limitation: One fixed neutral start per case; deterministic world-frame pushes are not broad stochastic robustness or a walk-to-stand transition.

conclusion: No checkpoint passes the complete robustness suite. The first four fail negative-X recovery; the final checkpoint falls before the force pulse. Do not promote the last checkpoint or launch another identical training run.

failure_video_review.method: Inspected four-camera snapshots at reset, 5.0, 5.2, 5.5, 6.0 and terminal 6.94 seconds.
failure_video_review.observation: Upright pre-pulse, loss of balance after force release, then a fall consistent with the scalar trace.
